readings.source_reading: Line 1: 'ff 1-8, Śk.1727', with a rule running right to the gutter and continuing on fol. 100 to a '√ₓ' tick. Line 2: 'ff.1-6, in 109b[u/a]n[?]', with a '←' and a short rule from the gutter toward a '√ ▮' tick one row lower.
readings.evidence: Tile at [1604,3216]: line 1 is at about canvas y 4140–4216 and its rule is at y ≈4176. Line 2 is at about y 4231–4291 and its rule is at y ≈4236. The word after '109' has a final flourish and could be 'bun' or 'ban'. 'Śk' has an accent mark over the S. The final digit of '1727' looks like a 7 but is slightly unclear.

readings.source_reading: The '⇐ a/' and both '←→' arrows lie left of the fold, on fol. 99b. The '←' arrows at about y 3806 and 3871 are also left of the fold. The paired '→' arrows, the pencil '?'/'x' marks beside them, the upper '→' leading into the pencil oval, the oval note itself and the '5/' marks all lie right of the fold, on fol. 100.
readings.evidence: The binding thread and fold are at canvas x ≈3190–3245. The b901 marks are at x ≈2870–3104 and the b902 marks at x ≈3039–3114, both left of the fold. The fol. 100 native tile shows the same '⇐ a/' and '←→' at its far left, before its gutter.
The strokes read t-i-t-t-(h?)-i. There is no 'l' or 'e' form, so 'title' is not supported.

readings.source_reading: The two rules are at separate heights. The upper rule (≈y 4176) runs to the '√ₓ' tick. The lower rule (≈y 4236) runs to the '√ ▮' tick on the next row of fol. 100.
